recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the remaining current-source omission from FHIR-22689 while preserving later FHIR-20171/FHIR-37906 wording cleanup and avoiding duplicate decisions for related issues already represented on the combined branch.
issue_request: FHIR-22689 is Applied/Persuasive for R5. FM asked to clarify the confusing Claim.provider description so it would be understood as the billing provider/accountable party rather than necessarily the rendering or servicing provider, and the resolution directed the same comment update across Claim, ClaimResponse, ExplanationOfBenefit, CoverageEligibilityRequest, CoverageEligibilityResponse, and PaymentReconciliation.
initial_application: Commit 7af5ba658c1a44e83e5feb8bba39498da34bba3a applied FHIR-22689 to several financial resources but omitted PaymentReconciliation. CoverageEligibilityResponse was later completed under FHIR-40940. Before this reconciliation, PaymentReconciliation.requestor still said it was the practitioner responsible for services rendered.
additional_context: PaymentReconciliation is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-17996 shows PaymentReconciliation.requestProvider/requestor is the provider/payee-side party, and the current requestor search parameter describes the provider who submitted the claim. FHIR-20171 and FHIR-37906 later removed the cardinality lead-in from this comment family, so the current trimmed Billing Provider wording is the right target. FHIR-26601 expanded PaymentReconciliation to patient-payment use cases but did not redefine requestor.
reconciliation: Updated source/paymentreconciliation/structuredefinition-PaymentReconciliation.xml to set PaymentReconciliation.requestor short/definition to the request-provider role and add the FHIR-22689 Billing Provider/accountability comment. Updated the checked-in PaymentReconciliation SVG tooltip for the same element so the diagram no longer repeats the stale services-rendered definition.
source_changes: source/paymentreconciliation/structuredefinition-PaymentReconciliation.xml: updated PaymentReconciliation.requestor short, definition, and comment.
source/paymentreconciliation/paymentreconciliation.svg: updated the PaymentReconciliation.requestor tooltip to match the clarified definition.
